why: Both analyses match the key almost point for point on hedgehog, stop-doing, brutal facts and decline risks; Analysis 1 is better calibrated because it explicitly names the missing per-pipeline deploy and incident-rate data and states its confidence. Analysis 2 has the sharper action-first verdict and slightly more usable guidance for the leader (a concrete rewritten Q4 OKR, the rollback-versus-approval compliance conflict, a fallback if the headcount is withdrawn), which narrowly wins overall.
